platform.componentPreviewPolicy: Runtime components are native Slint. This sidecar records source and behavior; it contains no fabricated HTML/CSS component assets.
platform.units: Slint logical pixels. Client captures and Slint scale overrides do not establish physical Windows DPI transitions.

accent.purpose: Primary action, focus, draft path and selected keyboard group.

derivation.muted: mix(canvas, foreground, 0.70), falling back to foreground if contrast on hover is below 4.5:1
derivation.on-accent: Black or white, whichever has greater contrast against accent

validation: Invalid or partial edits retain the last valid appearance preview
Save persists the local appearance draft
appearance.persistence: Separate versioned ui-settings.json preserves app-settings.json readability for older protected helpers; normal save failures retain rollback and concurrent-change checks.
appearance.authority: Appearance preview changes no profile, hardware, recovery or startup permission.

body.purpose: Default Segoe UI text in the main and About windows.

section.purpose: Semibold instruments and grouped work areas.

product-mark.purpose: Compact command-bar name beside an original geometric Path mark.

metric-unavailable.purpose: Explicit unavailable text in the smaller metric role.

chart-label.purpose: Y-axis values outside the clipped plot.

nativeGeometry.commandBar: 44 logical px high; 16 logical px side insets
nativeGeometry.navigation: Three equal targets in a 300 logical px strip; Settings separate
nativeGeometry.density: 20 logical px content inset; predominantly 8/12 logical px spacing
nativeGeometry.compactBehavior: Bounded scrolling with persistent mounted drafts and Undo
nativeGeometry.popup: Field width; bounded ScrollView; wrapped variable-height rows revealed from actual row geometry
nativeGeometry.chartPlot: 46 logical px left and 12 top; width minus 60 and height minus 28; paths, markers and pointer input share the plot

nativeComponents.name: Primary native action
nativeComponents.description: Accent/on-accent action with common control geometry, keyboard activation and focus.
nativeComponents.states: Primary retains accent/on-accent; pressed and keyboard focus use an on-accent boundary.

nativeComponents.name: Secondary native action
nativeComponents.description: Control/ink action with tonal hover and focus.
nativeComponents.states: Hover and pressed use hover/ink; pressed boundary is accent. Disabled uses surface/quiet.

nativeComponents.name: Native text field
nativeComponents.description: Native TextInput with caret, selection, IME, clipped horizontal editing, clipboard/context actions and Undo.
nativeComponents.states: Focus uses an accent boundary. Appearance errors retain the previous valid preview.

nativeComponents.name: Native selector
nativeComponents.description: Common closed field with bounded, scrollable, wrapped choices.
nativeComponents.states: Open arrows/Home/End move and reveal the pending variable-height row. Enter/click commits; Escape cancels.

nativeComponents.name: Equal navigation
nativeComponents.description: Equal Overview/Cooling/Lighting targets; selected fill, focus outline and hit area use the same geometry. Settings is separate.

nativeComponents.name: Collapsible section
nativeComponents.description: Flat surface heading with a drawn chevron, focus and keyboard activation; help appears on demand.

nativeComponents.name: Connected curve canvas
nativeComponents.description: Actual connected Path for accent draft and muted opening reference, with a textual legend.
nativeComponents.states: Axes are outside the clipped plot; markers and pointer input share plot coordinates in software and femtovg rendering.

nativeComponents.name: Schematic keyboard
nativeComponents.description: Original QWERTZ/QWERTY geometry with draft zone tint, color underline and selected-group boundary.
nativeComponents.states: WASD = zone 3; Rest = zones 1/2; NUM pad/right = zone 0 including adjacent keys. Group buttons provide keyboard access. This is not per-key RGB.
nativeComponents.behavior: Picker/hex, On/Off and RGB-value brightness remain drafts until guarded Apply/readback. Reset and exit protection preserve the transaction.

nativeComponents.name: Native brightness control
nativeComponents.description: Accent track/thumb, focus boundary and numeric alternative for RGB-value brightness.
nativeComponents.states: 0–100 in single steps, with arrows, Home/End and semantic slider actions. No firmware master-brightness byte is invented.

documentationEvidence.scope: Native source and existing isolated client captures. This documentation pass performed no app or hardware action, physical DPI transition, lifecycle qualification or resource measurement.

narrative.overview:
The Rust/Slint system is a modern, clean Windows utility for frequent hardware checks and careful editing. Discord-inspired Slate neutrals, a restrained indigo accent and Antigravity-style appearance choices give the workbench one shared system.

Measured GPU watts and temperature lead, with verified CPU telemetry beside them; editable presets follow in the same work area. Native editing, alignment, readable fields and explicit actions distinguish selected intent, draft edits, metadata saves and confirmed hardware state.

The UI remains native and offline. Product and hardware contracts stay authoritative; visual corrections establish no new hardware, startup, resource or lifecycle qualification.
keyCharacteristics: Common control geometry and aligned values.
Derived palettes with validated local previews.
Explicit draft, saved and confirmed state.
Connected paths and an original schematic keyboard.
Event-driven rendering with low background resource use.

rules.name: The Shared Palette Rule
rules.body: Reuse semantic theme roles throughout the native UI; do not create separate popup, chart or settings palettes.

rules.name: The Valid Preview Rule
rules.body: Only valid opaque colors meeting source contrast thresholds replace the previous preview; Save persists it.

rules.name: The Exact Value Rule
rules.body: Preserve units, exact numbers and configured/requested/effective/measured distinctions in both languages.

rules.name: The One Work Area Rule
rules.body: Keep Overview instruments and preset editing mounted together, with explicit actions and preserved drafts/Undo.

rules.name: The State Before Color Rule
rules.body: Name busy, error, draft, saved, unavailable and confirmed states in text; color reinforces them.

dos: Do retain native Windows behavior, native Slint text editing and visible keyboard focus.
Do distinguish selected intent, drafts, metadata saves and confirmed hardware readback.
Do keep bounded telemetry, expected-state checks, readback and recovery.
Do verify both languages, compact/enlarged clients, popup scrolling/focus, both renderers, drafts/Undo and palette recovery.
Do isolate developer-only MCP and marked fixtures from the live user store.
Do measure total tray resources including resident helpers; keep results in Validation.
donts: Don't infer sensor readings or call Windows MHz a measured boost clock.
Don't present previews, saves, palette changes or fixtures as firmware operations.
Don't describe keyboard groups as per-key RGB or numpad-only control.
Don't add a browser runtime, raster decoration, downloaded fonts, decorative motion or continuous rendering.
Don't infer new hardware support, 85 °C enforcement, HP-controller independence, physical DPI transition or complete accessibility qualification from visual corrections.
